title: REVOLUTION MEN'S LEAGUE | WEEK 4 RECAP
content: Week 4 was electric. Will Ewald poured in 36 points and hauled down 17 rebounds to lift Blue over Green. White rolled past Orange behind Asko Mostarlic's 27 and Andy Bousono's absurd 12-assist, 14-rebound line. Matt Riordan's 31 points and buzzer-beater helped Black survive Gray by a single point. Matt Spear and Peter Walsh combined for 54 as Pink kept its perfect record intact. Let's get into the action.

games.text: Blue came out sizzling. Will Ewald stretched the floor, and the Blue offense flowed through John Helsel, who dealt out eight assists. Kolby Bradford and Kyle Picard supplied steady buckets as well. Ewald also found his range from deep, ending the game 6-of-13 from three. As a result, Blue carried a ten-point lead to the break. Halftime: Blue 51, Green 41. Green turned up the heat after the break. Fab Anthony carried the Green attack on his back, piling up 38 points on 15-of-32 shooting. James Hare knocked down three triples, while Hans Lynn chipped in 14, and Peter Lindholm collected nine rebounds to go with 13 points. Green edged the half 38-37, yet the cushion never shrank enough to matter. Blue took the opener, 88-79.

performers.Blue: Will Ewald — 36 pts, 17 reb, 2 ast, 2 blk, 3 stl; John Helsel — 23 pts, 12 reb, 8 ast, 1 stl; Kolby Bradford — 14 pts, 7 reb, 5 ast, 1 stl
performers.Green: Fab Anthony — 38 pts, 11 reb, 2 ast; James Hare — 14 pts, 6 reb, 2 ast, 1 stl; Peter Lindholm — 13 pts, 9 reb, 1 ast, 1 stl

games.text: White wasted no time in this one. Aaron West shot 9-of-14 on his way to 19 points, as Asko Mostarlic bullied his way to the rim. Aid Semic and Andy Bousono owned the glass, and Bousono kept the ball moving like a pinball. Kyle Haley answered with a barrage of threes for Orange, but White's balance proved tougher to stop. A nine-point lead was waiting at the break. Halftime: White 44, Orange 35. Orange searched for answers in the second half. Kyle Haley kept bombing away, finishing 7-of-19 from deep for 25 points. Kerry Lyons turned the boards into his personal property with 16 rebounds, and he never missed at the line, going 4-for-4. Carter Beeman added 10 boards, and Edo Semic put up 14 points. Orange scored 41 in the half, but White poured in 47, so the gap only grew. White cruised to a 91-76 victory.

performers.White: Asko Mostarlic — 27 pts, 11 reb, 5 ast, 2 stl; Aid Semic — 14 pts, 14 reb, 2 ast, 1 stl; Andy Bousono — 12 pts, 14 reb, 12 ast, 2 stl
performers.Orange: Kyle Haley — 25 pts, 3 reb, 5 ast, 2 stl; Kerry Lyons — 14 pts, 16 reb, 6 ast, 1 stl; Carter Beeman — 14 pts, 10 reb, 2 ast, 1 blk

games.text: Black grabbed the early momentum. Matt Riordan scored at every level, and Brody Snow dropped 20 on 9-of-15 shooting. Nick Lynn cleaned up the misses, and Drew Fisher spun five assists out of the Black sets. Gray managed only 28 points, and Black took a ten-point lead into the locker room. Halftime: Black 38, Gray 28. Gray stormed back after the break, and the final minutes were a nail-biter. Cory Chaplin ignited the rally, sinking six threes on his way to 22 points. Cyle Chaplin hit four of his seven from deep, while Jaren Jeffcoat piled up 13 points, 13 rebounds and three steals. Jeromy Anderson added 12 more, and Gray even took a two-point lead. It looked like they were about to complete the full comeback. Sadly, a desperation three-pointer from Matt Riordan sealed the win for Black, so they survived, 68-67.

performers.Black: Matt Riordan — 31 pts, 14 reb, 2 ast, 2 blk, 1 stl; Brody Snow — 20 pts, 10 reb, 4 ast, 1 blk; Drew Fisher — 9 pts, 6 reb, 5 ast, 1 blk
performers.Gray: Cory Chaplin — 22 pts, 2 reb, 2 ast; Jaren Jeffcoat — 13 pts, 13 reb, 5 ast, 1 blk, 3 stl; Jeromy Anderson — 12 pts, 6 reb, 1 blk, 1 stl

games.text: Pink stayed locked in. Matt Spear conducted the offense, and Peter Walsh finished everything near the rim. Dylan Pratico handed out six assists, and Jake Dion pickpocketed three steals. Red hung around behind Drew Pelkey's touch at the stripe, but Pink slowly built an eight-point edge. Halftime: Pink 40, Red 32. Red refused to fold in the second half. Logan Letourneau grabbed 12 rebounds on his way to 20 points, and Drew Pelkey went a flawless 7-for-7 at the line for 22. Cam Perta launched sixteen triples and made four, while Alex Philo ripped down ten boards. But Pink answered with 45 points in the half to keep the door shut. Pink earned an 85-74 win and improved to 4-0.
